catch-fishing.name: “Catching Fish by the Light” Project, “Alanika 2024” Contemporary Art Festival
catch-fishing.description: October 4, 2024 - ∞ Museum of History of Fishing Industry, Makhachkala, Dagestan November 15 - December 5, 2024 North Caucasus branch of Pushkin State Museum of Fine Arts, Vladikavkaz
paintDescription: The installation in the Museum of the History of the Fishing Industry is dedicated to one of the ways of catching fish - using artificial light.

Like the movement of a fish attracted by a bright light, the visitor of the museum reacts to the achievements of thought and labor of a man who is faithfully serving his cause. The history of the earth is formed from the humble stories of each worker, the success of a large industry depends on a single, sometimes unknown person. The light of selfless daily work of generations of ordinary fishermen, workers of the fishing industry of Dagestan, still reaches us and testifies to the scale of the invested labor, attracts attention, causes admiration and respect.

imagePaths.descrip: Installation «Catching Fish by the Light» in Vladikavkaz

paintDescription: Oblivion seems unfair to each of these people, whose portraits are everywhere on the walls of the museum. That is why the idea to make a symbolic curtain, a “pantheon of heroes” or a symbolic board of honor was born.

A light translucent fabric with portraits of fishery workers printed on it, paired with a curtain depicting tons of fish, is placed at the entrance to the museum and precedes the first exposition hall, the “memorial office of the head of the plant”.

The installation “Catching Fish by the Light,” which opens the museum's general exhibition, is a composition that consists of a vintage fishing cage attached to the ceiling and turned into a lamp, and old barrels with metal-cut sprat. Some of the barrels contain mirrors that create the illusion of being filled with water and reflect the parachute cloth-covered ceiling that imitates the water surface.

Also, on the walls in this hall are applied graphic schemes - drawings depicting the fish catching by the light. Old showcases have been turned into lightboxes representing pages from old atlases and books with images of fish living in the Caspian Sea.
Aquariums that have long been out of use have become backlit mirror exposition modules, where the museum's exhibits are placed in a new combination and connection.
The bright entrance area becomes a kind of a bridge between the present and the past, which is represented in the authentic exhibition of the fishing industry museum.
— Katerina Kovaleva

cosmocow.name: Contemporary Art Fair “COSMOSCOW 2024”
cosmocow.description:
October 24 - October 27, 2024 
 Timiryazev Center, Moscow 

 “These objects are reminiscent of known Archaic examples in their stylistics and more conventional “smoothed” stonework. Homer used the appellation “kouros” for young soldiers. So lost body parts, their replacement, can be seen as a sign of heroism.

paintDescription:
I am interested in the illusion of the substitution/replacement of the sublime and the earthy, with the dualism of the opposition between the sacred (soul) and the profane (body).

 I tried to combine the idea of eternity of a stone and ephemerality of snow, the form of an ideal body and “accidental” someone else's dummy/head, when all the well-known clichés about a healthy body and a healthy spirit are questioned.”
— Katerina Kovaleva

limbo.name: «LIMBO»
limbo.description: September 4 – October 31, 2024 CREA Center for Contemporary Art, Venice
paintDescription: The main idea of the project is to accumulate hope through an exploration of the phenomenon of waiting, using a parachute as a symbol of a metaphorical sky and expectation.

In addition to works from the «Waiting Area» series, the exhibition features the installation «Rape of Europe», consisting of three pieces («Rape of Europe», «Triumph of the Continents», «Europe’s Wedding Dress»), which symbolically reflects the experience of the processes unfolding in the world, primarily in the social and cultural spheres.

II. At the center of the former Venetian shipyards stands a 9-meter-tall parachute titled «The Triumph of the Continents», which features allegorical depictions of Europe, Africa, Asia, and America (based on a work by Tiepolo). Unity in diversity. Only by preserving its identity and cultural code can humanity survive.

III. Also part of the installation is a six-meter-tall wedding dress made of a parachute, with a map of Europe printed on it. This is an image of Europe as the eternal bride, who has a map of escape in reserve, and this will help her return to reality, to her homeland, to herself.
Abducted Europe, amidst a stormy sea, cries out for help. She must fly across the ocean, balancing on the back of a bull that looks more like a gentle lamb or a faithful dog.
Will Europe resign herself to the fact that she is drifting farther from her native shores?..

like-my-father.name: «In my father's field» Project for the 80th Anniversary of Victory in WWII
like-my-father.description: May 2025 North Caucasus Branch of the Pushkin State Museum of Fine Arts, Vladikavkaz
paintDescription: The installation «Memorial Table» consists of a long table covered with white cloth, on which stand 40 glasses of water, covered with small pieces of stone (granite) resembling black bread, as well as 40 soldiers’ bowls covered with a mirror imitating water.
These mirrors reflect a parachute stretched over the table like a dome, depicting the Angel of Memory, as well as lines from soldiers’ letters and death notices.

Performance «Letter of Hope». 1,418 envelopes (representing the number of days of the war) are stamped with specially made stamps. Inside, one can place a photograph of a relative who fought in the war, a portrait of a soldier, a quote, or a fragment of a letter.
Participants in the performance stamp the envelope (1945–2025) and send it into the future — placing it in a symbolic mailbox or arranging the envelopes into a canvas.
